subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRefs become activation-required under the current fail-fast contract now, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS startup policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: The bug fix restores the documented eager SecretRef contract, but it also exposes previously skipped persona credentials to startup failure; only maintainers can choose the intended release sequencing for that availability change.

options.title: Land under strict contract
options.body: After fixing the traversal and proof blockers, land this PR with the existing documented fail-fast activation behavior and handle optional degradation separately.

options.title: Sequence after fail-open policy
options.body: Wait for the optional-TTS startup decision so persona credential collection cannot newly prevent Gateway startup.

recommendation.title: Land under strict contract
recommendation.body: After fixing the traversal and proof blockers, land this PR with the existing documented fail-fast activation behavior and handle optional degradation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available routing signal for the current SecretRef activation contract and its release sequencing.
